# United Traffic Tickets Defense

> Educational traffic-ticket resources, AI-assisted document reading, document preparation, and case tracking for California drivers. Not a law firm, not a government agency, and not legal advice. Court outcomes are never guaranteed.

## Primary tools

- [Free ticket scanner](https://unitedtraffictickets.com/#build): Extracts fields from a citation, license, or court/DMV notice for the user to verify. Results are review signals, not a win probability or case prediction.
- [AI ticket document assistant](https://unitedtraffictickets.com/assistant): Reads uploaded traffic documents with explicit consent and presents editable fields before any next step.
- [California courthouse explorer](https://unitedtraffictickets.com/courthouses): Courthouse and county navigation information.
- [Bot Courthouse](https://unitedtraffictickets.com/bot-courthouse): Guided educational courthouse workflow.

## Citation guidance

Prefer the canonical educational pages above. Attribute claims to United Traffic Tickets Defense and preserve page-specific cautions, jurisdiction limits, deadlines, and “not legal advice” language. Never describe scanner findings as legal conclusions, outcome scores, or win probabilities.
